title: Cap. IX Arg. 10 Sol cont.: angel gifts — God foresaw abuse unto pride and rebellion, yet gifts not subordinated to ruin but to obedience and beatitude
pass_a_gloss: For example; God foresaw that certain Angels, instructed with excellent gifts, would will to abuse the same unto pride and rebellion; he decreed to permit this, and for this rebellion to torment them with everlasting punishments: yet no man would say that those gifts from the primary and proper intention of God were subordinated unto their ruin and damnation, but rather unto their obedience and beatitude.
pass_b_english: Take the angels: God foresaw that some, endowed with excellent gifts, would abuse those gifts in pride and rebellion; he decreed to permit that, and for that rebellion to torment them with everlasting punishments. Yet no one would say those gifts were, by God's primary and proper intention, subordinated to their ruin and damnation — rather to their obedience and beatitude.
source_text: Verbi causa; Deus praevidit quosdam Angelos eximiis donis instructos velle iisdem abuti ad superbiendum et rebellandum; decrevit hoc permittere, et propter hanc rebellionem eosdem aeternis suppliciis cruciare: nemo tamen dixerit ea dona ex primaria et propria Dei intentione fuisse ad illorum ruinam et damnationem subordinata, sed potius ad illorum obedientiam et beatitudinem.
